title: Common Type descriptor properties
$comment: Review candidate. This is the properties schema of Type and therefore the common descriptor schema. Affiliation with BeadType or LinkType supplies category-specific validation. Shape validation is not Type admission.

propertiesSchema.$comment: Embedded JSON Schema, not a URL. Root-only dialect shape check; every schema resource in the retained closure must use the standard 2020-12 dialect. Resource discovery and closure admission are separate checks, not a scan of literal data keys. No general executable extension language is selected initially; unsupported required semantics refuse.

schemaResources.$comment: Candidate retrieval-URI to exact schema-resource map, immutable with Type revision. Values retain standard $id/base/anchor semantics. Complete closure, conflicting bindings and offline resolution require admission checks.

version.$comment: Optional informational author release label; labels may repeat across exact revisions. No inferred conformance, revision matching or upgrade.

abstract.description: True forbids direct instance affiliation with this exact definition. Does not automatically make refinements abstract.

propertyAccess.$comment: Exact JSON Pointer paths through object members relative to instance properties. Arrays are whole values initially. Omission adds no local restriction; inherited restrictions still apply. Path applicability, nested restrictions and write enforcement require semantic checks.

typeSelector.$comment: Candidate selector syntax. Pinned entries match exact affiliation/conformance; unpinned entries match any revision of the identity or conformance to such a revision, never latest lookup. any:true imposes no Type restriction.

participationConstraint.$comment: Candidate Bead participation rule: min omitted means zero; max omitted means unbounded. min<=max and intersection with inherited/Link bounds need semantic validation.

endpointConstraint.$comment: Candidate endpoint syntax. Scope conditions remain binding. Typed cross/either Bead arms can match registered exact Type-definition endpoints using retained accepted facts; arbitrary external resources remain opaque and cannot establish a specific Type. Registration/exact-state admission is semantic, not proved by this shape schema. resource admits an opaque external URI and does not enable local Link endpoints. Scope classification and floating external-definition resolution remain to specify.

allowSelf.description: False prohibits equal source and target Resource identities, ignoring revision selectors. True or omission adds no local prohibition; inherited prohibitions remain binding.

linkConstraints.$comment: Arity, ordered-pair uniqueness and directed acyclicity apply to the combined family, not separately to pair alternatives. unique/acyclic false or omission adds no local restriction; allowSelf false imposes an identity self-link prohibition, true or omission does not. No local value disables inherited restrictions. No Link minimum or endpoint pin-mode field.
